parallels.note: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.

translations.web: Then he says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came out,’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.
translations.bsb: Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’ On its return, it finds the house vacant, swept clean, and put in order.
translations.kjv: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
translations.asv: Then he saith, I will return into my house whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
